---
title: "Data Import Script"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Scraping Country Names

```{r}
url <- "https://www.numbeo.com/food-prices/"

##scrape country names
country_names <-
  read_html(url)|>
  html_elements("table.related_links")|>
  html_elements("a")|>
  html_text2()

##scrape country URLs
country_links <-
  read_html(url)|>
  html_elements("table.related_links")|>
  html_elements("a")|>
  html_attr("href")|>
  url_absolute(base=url)
  
countries <- tibble(
  country = country_names,
  url = country_links
)

countries
```
